name: led-matrix
description: Plays a working animation on an MCP2221 + HT16K33 LED matrix while Claude works, blanks it when Claude is done, and counts down to the reset while the usage limit is hit.

binary.title: claudematrix program
binary.description: Path to the claudematrix program that drives the matrix.

addr.title: I2C address
addr.description: I2C address of the matrix, 0x70 to 0x77, set with the jumpers on its back (passed to claudematrix as -addr).

limitFile.title: Usage-limit file
limitFile.description: Where the usage limit's reset time is written for claudematrix's countdown. claudematrix reads ~/.claude/usage-limit unless given -limit.
